auth.welcome: Sign in to reach your teams, projects and tasks.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.hint: Drag a card's handle to rearrange the board.

projects.title: Projects
projects.name: Name
projects.emptyBody: Create the first project to start organising the team's work.

task.title: Title
task.assigneesHint: One person can be on several projects and tasks.
task.deleteBody: This task and all of its sub-tasks will be removed. This cannot be undone.
task.timerAlreadyRunning: You already have a timer running. Stop it first.

myTasks.title: My tasks
myTasks.emptyBody: When someone assigns you to a task, it shows up here.

teams.title: Teams
teams.name: Name
teams.emptyBody: Create a team to group the people who work together.

spaces.title: Spaces
spaces.privateHint: Visible only to members of the space.
spaces.emptyBody: Spaces organise work by department, client or initiative.

resources.title: Resource allocation
resources.emptyBody: Assign people to tasks to track their workload.

chat.title: Internal chat
chat.emptyBody: Be the first to write in this channel.
chat.noChannelBody: Pick a channel on the left to read its messages.

settings.title: Settings
settings.sessionsHint: Where your account is signed in. End any session you do not recognise.
settings.notificationsHint: Choose how each kind of alert reaches you. Anything you switch off stops being sent — the digest still gathers whatever was held back.
settings.digestHint: Gathers into one message whatever was not sent immediately.
settings.capacityHint: How many hours a week you are available for. Capacity planning compares allocated work against this number.
settings.privacyHint: Download everything the system holds about you. Erasure is irreversible and sits with an administrator.
settings.serviceTokensHint: Machine credentials for SCIM provisioning and read-only reporting. Only the hash is stored.
settings.tokenShownOnce: Copy it now: this secret is never shown again.

errors.genericBody: The operation could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.networkBody: Check your connection and try again.
errors.notFoundBody: The item you are looking for does not exist or was removed.
errors.forbiddenBody: You do not have permission to view or change this item.
errors.boundaryBody: This page stopped working. Reloading usually fixes it.

views.label: Views
views.timelineEmptyBody: Give tasks a start and due date to see them on the timeline.

docs.title: Docs
docs.hint: Notes, decisions and reference material, written in Markdown. Every save keeps the previous version.
docs.emptyBody: Create the first document in this space.

goals.title: Goals and OKRs
goals.hint: Objectives and the key results that measure them. A measure can be read straight from the tasks, so a goal cannot drift from the work.
goals.name: Name
goals.spaceHint: Leave empty for an organisation-wide goal.
goals.emptyBody: State the first objective and how it will be measured.
goals.noMeasures: No key results. A goal without a measure is an intention.
goals.measureSourceHint: Manual is yours to update; the others are read from the project tasks.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.hint: Every project at once: health, progress, and whether the people are over-committed.
portfolio.restrictedBody: The portfolio names every project and its health, so only managers and administrators can open it.
portfolio.capacityHint: Committed hours against the hours each person actually has. A task estimate is shared between its assignees.
portfolio.earnedValueHint: Measured against the approved baseline, in hours. The system holds estimates and tracked time but no rates — inventing one would produce a number that looks authoritative and is not.
portfolio.baselineFailed: The baseline could not be captured
portfolio.noBaselineBody: Without an approved plan there is nothing to measure against. Capture a baseline to start.

admin.title: System settings
admin.hint: Integrations an administrator can change without a redeploy. Changes take effect immediately — no restart needed.
admin.restrictedBody: These settings decide who may sign in and where e-mail goes. Only administrators can read or change them.
admin.mirrorOn: Mirrored to {{path}}. The database is authoritative; the file is for backup and review.
admin.mirrorOff: File mirroring is off. Set SETTINGS_ENV_FILE to enable it.
admin.groupHint_ad: Authentication against the company directory. Local accounts keep working.
admin.groupHint_smtp: Used for deadline alerts, assignments and digests. Switched off, messages go to the log.
admin.groupHint_oidc: Sign in through an identity provider. Register the redirect URL with the provider exactly as written here.
admin.groupHint_alerts: How many days before a due date each assignee is warned.
admin.groupHint_retention: Zero keeps everything. Unread notifications are never expired.
admin.testHint: Sends a real message with the settings in force. Save before testing.
admin.testAdHint: Tries a bind against the directory. The credentials are used for this attempt only and are never stored.
